title: Data Lake, Warehouse & Lakehouse (Data Lake, Warehouse & Lakehouse)
lead: Menjelaskan data mart, warehouse, lake, lakehouse. Menganalisis kelebihan/kekurangan + contoh penerapan.

sections.label: Data Lake, Warehouse & Lakehouse
sections.title: 1. Definisi
body: Warehouse: terstruktur, skema-on-write, optimal untuk BI/SQL (Snowflake, BigQuery). Lake: mentah multi-format, skema-on-read, murah (S3 + Parquet/Iceberg). Lakehouse: gabungan — lake murah + transaksi/ACID + SQL performan (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi). Mart: subset warehouse per departemen.
sections.callout: Bahan Bacaan: Kimball & Ross (2013) Ch.1; Dehghani (2022); Reis & Housley (2022) Ch.5

sections.label: Data Lake, Warehouse & Lakehouse
sections.title: 2. Perbandingan
body: Warehouse: kualitas & governance kuat, biaya storage/compute tinggi. Lake: fleksibel & murah, risiko jadi 'data swamp' tanpa katalog. Lakehouse: modern default untuk analitik + ML. Data Mesh (Dehghani): desentralisasi kepemilikan per domain + federated governance.

sections.label: Data Lake, Warehouse & Lakehouse
sections.title: 3. Contoh
body: Universitas: lake (log LMS mentah) → warehouse (dimensi mhs, fakta nilai) → mart (mart_akademik, mart_keuangan) → dashboard + early-warning DO. Format terbuka: Parquet + Iceberg agar antar-engine interoperable.
sections.callout: Istilah Kunci: Schema-on-write vs on-read, Lakehouse, Delta/Iceberg/Hudi, Data mart, Data mesh

quiz.question: Schema-on-read adalah ciri…
quiz.explanation: Lake simpan mentah, skema saat dibaca.

quiz.question: Lakehouse menggabungkan…
options: Lake murah + transaksi/ACID & SQL performan ala warehouse

quiz.question: Risiko 'data swamp'…
quiz.explanation: Tanpa metadata & quality gates, lake tak usable.
